title: One override route with a receipt: the owner's typed words are judged, override with any length form is the fast path, and each grant prints one receipt line
why: Owner R12, 16:10 CST Nov 10 (relayed by the retrospective session): "yes this statement of opus 4h etc also feels super arbitrary i dont want to do such rigid word grants moreso like if i say send a swarm of opus agents that just works too yanno? A is good though but it should be override <anytime> or override not just override and override 4h".
note: One route reads the owner's own typed words, overrides and Opus asks alike; fail closed; agent or pasted text never grants. Fast path, no model call: override (one act) or override plus any length form (15, 15m, 90 minutes, 2 hours, 4h). Other wording is judged (e.g. 'send a swarm of opus agents'); fixed forms like 'opus 2h' no longer needed. Each grant prints one receipt line ('Override: one act, guard X' or 'until 18:10 CST'). A refusal no override lifts says so. Departs from main: 'override 15m please' granting nothing, and '?' or 'opus' ruling a prompt out of the route. Home: decision owner-override, rewritten in place; CLAUDE.md rule roles-sonnet-is-the-ceiling override forms to match. Owner Q1, 09:10 CST Nov 11 ("q1 -- yes", in the coordinator's chat; relayed by the coordinator 09:11 and the retrospective 09:12): an override may travel by relay, only in R18 point 5's form (exact words, time, the one session and act, checked against the sender's feedback log); the receiver prints the receipt line. Until R18 point 5's check is built, only typed words and a page save grant an override. Plan R12 (3.11) and R13 point 3, restart-plan 7706893. Home: decision owner-override (the 3.11 lane rewrites it). Owner page save 12:54 CST Nov 12: item 601 a: a one-act override ends when used, on `override off`, or at the owner's next typed message; an Opus ask with no length lasts until session end or `opus off`.
